title: Month calendar
summary: The archive becomes a month calendar (Po–Ne): every day with a board is a square cell tinted by your result (dark blue = whole board, light blue = played, white = not played, red = today) and shows the score or "hrát". Hovering or tapping a day shows its question, your result and a red "Hrát" / "Zobrazit výsledek" button in a panel beside the grid (below it on phones).
tradeoffs: Strongest habit cue (gaps in a streak are obvious), but the questions are no longer scannable as a list; you see one question at a time.
